reference_design.direct_forward: 32 f32 dense matmul/ReLU layers; stream one 256-line basis plus antipodes

storage_and_ram.comment: The direct reference is RAM-feasible only when streamed; never materialize layer-by-path tensors.

arithmetic_only_wall_projection_hours.qualification: Arithmetic lower bound only. FlopScope dispatch, allocation, QR, f32 reduction, thermal throttling, and reproducibility constraints can increase wall time materially; only the discarded-output throughput fixture could certify feasibility.

inference_cost_of_killed_mechanism.ridge_readout_and_normalization: less than 1 million operations; included conservatively inside the message-bank envelope

decision: RAM is adequate and arithmetic cost is plausible but unmeasured; capacity and semantics fail before any campaign is justified.
